about: The spin wheel (#150; additions "Spin wheel"; decision 0266). The wheel's prizes are points, bonus in whole ₹50 chips, or nothing, each with a weight: its odds among the others. A spin draws a roll from 0 to the odds less one, the odds being the weights of the prizes that can be drawn; the roll lands on those prizes in the wheel's order, each taking as many rolls as its weight. A bonus prize more than what is left of the club month's spin.budget is left off the wheel for that spin; with nothing that can be drawn there is no spin. A case's prizes are separated by semicolons, each with its weight after ×; the expected prize is its place on the wheel, or none.

cases.description: The first roll lands on the first prize.
The last of the first prize's three rolls.
The next roll moves to the second prize.
The last roll lands on the last prize.
A bonus equal to what is left of the budget can still be drawn.
A bonus a paisa past the budget is left off: the rolls skip it.
No budget left: points and nothing are still drawn.
Only bonus prizes and no budget left: no spin.
